title: Kissed with Coriander Italian Veal Ossobuco
description: A Low-fat Friendly, Post-Workout Italian Dish Featuring Coriander Seeds, Fold, and Low-fat-friendly, Inspired by Liguria, Featuring Butter and a Savory Flavor Profile. This Classic Italian Dish is Perfect for a Weeknight Dinner.
instructions: Season the veal shanks with salt and pepper.
Heat the ligurian olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the veal shanks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the veal shanks to a plate and set aside.
Add the ground coriander seeds to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the veal shanks to the pot and add the beef broth, bay leaves, and thyme.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Let the veal shanks rest for 10 minutes before slicing them thinly against the grain.
Serve the veal shanks with the rich and flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with a side of saut6ed spinach.
